text.jp:
ふっふっふ。私は大剣闘祭運営のアンナ。
でも、今日はちょっと違う用事なの。
text.official_en:
You know me as Anna, the administrator of the
Heroic Games, but my job today is a little different.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アンナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あなたの腕を見込んで頼みたいことがあるの。
話を聞いてくれないかしら？
text.official_en:
You seem like a skilled warrior, so I have a favor to
ask if you're willing to listen.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アンナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ちなみにセオドラ陛下、今回は神殿の内部でも
極秘の案件となります関係上――
text.official_en:
By the way, Queen Theodora, because this job is a
secret, and you never know who's listening...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アンナ

text.jp:
私の口調についても気軽な感じになりますけど、
これも世を欺く為ですので、ご協力下さいね。
text.official_en:
I might sound a little more casual than you're used to.
But trust me, there's good reason for it.

text.jp: <NCA>話を聞く
text.official_en: <NCA>Hear her out.

text.jp: <NCB>興味はない
text.official_en: <NCB>Decline the request.

<ACA>ありがとう！
それじゃ、早速内容についてなのだけど……
text.official_en: <ACA>Great! Then we can get straight to the details.

<ACB>そんなこと言わないで！
後生よ！　話だけでも聞いて頂戴。
text.official_en:
<ACB>Aw, don't be like that! At least let me tell you what
the favor is about.

text.jp:
ダグシオンの外れに、半分土に埋もれた
古い礼拝施設の跡地があるの。
text.official_en:
There was an old worship site on the outskirts of
Dagsion once. What's left of it is half buried now.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アンナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そこはかなり昔に放棄されていて、完全に
人の寄り付かない廃墟になっているのだけど。
text.official_en:
It was abandoned long ago. With no one keeping
the place in good shape, it fell into ruin.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アンナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どうもそこを無断で使っている人がいるみたいで、
私はそれを調べないといけないってわけ。
text.official_en:
But now I hear someone's been poking around it
without permission. I need to find out why.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アンナ

text.jp:
そこで、護衛をお願いできそうな人を探して
いたのだけど、あなたなら申し分ないわ！
text.official_en:
But I'd rather not go alone, and you seem like the
perfect backup!

どう？
お願いできないかしら？
text.official_en: What do you think? Are you in?

text.official_en: <TH>

……まあ、ちょっとばかし
危険な目には遭うかも知れないけど……
text.official_en: Now, fair warning, there might be some danger.

ね、悪い話じゃないでしょう？
text.official_en:
Which is why I'm willing to pay generously for it.
Not a bad deal, right?

都合の良いときに、また声をかけて頂戴！

探らなければならないんだけど……

I need to poke around the ruins of an old worship site
on the outskirts of Dagsion.
